meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把旧版安装平滑升级到新版
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在把旧版迁移到新版
copy.tagline_en: Finish upgrading your old install to the new version
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're moving from an old version to a new one

howto.what: 装上后,当你把 NanoClaw 从 v1 迁到 v2 时,Claude 会接手需要人工判断的收尾:检查迁移记录、把你设为负责人(owner)、搬移旧记忆、核对容器配置、协助移植自定义代码,最后整体验证。
howto.when: 当你说出“migrate from v1”“finish migration”或“v1 migration”,想收尾 v1→v2 迁移时触发;若还没运行 bash migrate-v2.sh,它会先提醒你运行。

say.note: 会先检查迁移记录;没跑脚本就先提醒你。

say.text: 我跑完迁移脚本了,接下来呢?
say.note: 会继续未完成的收尾步骤,如设 owner、迁旧记忆。

say.text: 把旧自定义代码也迁到 v2 吧
say.note: 会先判断是否为 fork,再协助移植或存档。

howto.what_en: Claude takes over the human-judgment parts of a NanoClaw v1→v2 migration: reads migration records, makes you the owner, moves legacy memory, reconciles container configs, helps port custom code, and finishes with an overall verification.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say “migrate from v1”, “finish migration”, or “v1 migration” to wrap up a v1→v2 migration. If bash migrate-v2.sh hasn't run yet, it asks you to run it first.

say_en.note: Checks migration records first; reminds you if the script hasn't run.

say_en.text: I ran the migration script. What's next?
say_en.note: Continues remaining steps like owner setup and memory migration.

say_en.text: Port my old custom code over to v2
say_en.note: Checks whether it's a fork, then helps migrate or archive it.
